g.text: neri census of public GitHub · Nov 2026 · n = 17,960 CLAUDE.md files · weighted; 'typical' = median size; token shares are pooled across files, so the card shows an average composition, not one file. Block heights follow them; line hints are decorative; no file text shown. Tokens counted with the o200k_base tokenizer, a proxy for Claude's own.
